subject.title: fix(zai): send user agent during endpoint detection

question: Should this Z.AI User-Agent fix require a maintainer-run redacted Coding Plan smoke before merge, or is the linked live issue proof plus source-level regression test enough for an explicit proof override?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and source-backed, but the external PR proof gate is not satisfied because the contributor lacks a Z.AI Coding Plan key and cannot demonstrate the after-fix service path themselves.

options.title: Run maintainer live smoke
options.body: A maintainer with a redacted Z.AI Coding Plan key runs endpoint detection on this head and records redacted terminal/log proof before merge.

options.title: Accept proof override
options.body: Maintainers explicitly accept the credential gap because the issue has live no-UA/UA service evidence and this patch only adds the matching provider-local header.

options.title: Use another canonical PR
options.body: Maintainers select one sibling candidate PR for the same linked issue and close the rest after that path lands.

recommendation.title: Run maintainer live smoke
recommendation.body: A maintainer with a redacted Z.AI Coding Plan key runs endpoint detection on this head and records redacted terminal/log proof before merge.
